embeds.title: Your ticket has been opened.
embeds.description:
Thanks for getting in touch! A member of staff will be with you shortly.

Please describe your issue in as much detail as you can — screenshots help.
This channel is private: only you and the staff team can see it.

footer.text: Tickets are archived when closed and a transcript is sent to you by DM. If your DMs are closed the transcript stays available in the panel.
